title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #17

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Bible passage says that we are fearfully and wonderfully made? (1 mark)
   A. Psalm 139
   B. Numbers 22
   C. Acts 2
   D. Matthew 6

2. Which of these things was created by God, according to the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Only the sea
   B. Only plants
   C. The sun, moon and stars
   D. Only humans

3. Which person in the Bible chose not to defile himself with the king's food? (1 mark)
   A. Samson
   B. Balaam
   C. Daniel
   D. Zacchaeus

4. What is a choice? (1 mark)
   A. A gift from a friend
   B. A decision to do one thing instead of another
   C. A school rule
   D. A kind of food

5. What should you say if someone tries to touch your private parts? (1 mark)
   A. Yes please
   B. Nothing
   C. Thank you
   D. No, stop!

6. What is a good rule when you are alone with people? (1 mark)
   A. Be careful and stay in open places
   B. Go to hidden places
   C. Share private pictures
   D. Accept lifts from strangers

7. Which group of books in the Old Testament is known as the Law? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua to Esther
   B. Job to Song of Songs
   C. Isaiah to Malachi
   D. Genesis to Deuteronomy

8. Which is the last book of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Acts
   B. Jude
   C. Revelation
   D. Malachi

9. What did the seven thin cows stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Seven servants
   B. Seven towns
   C. Seven years of plenty
   D. Seven years of famine

10. What did John call people to do? (1 mark)
   A. Repent
   B. Fight
   C. Rest
   D. Trade

11. What was Zechariah's job? (1 mark)
   A. Tax collector
   B. Priest
   C. Fisherman
   D. Soldier

12. Which person is showing gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. A child who forgets to thank
   B. A child who complains
   C. A child who laughs
   D. A child who thanks her neighbour for a kind act

13. Which of these is an act of compassion? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing at a friend's loss
   B. Ignoring a lonely child
   C. Comforting a grieving friend
   D. Teasing a sad friend

14. To reconcile means to: (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Become friends again after a quarrel
   C. Run away
   D. Fight

15. Who forgave his brothers who had sold him? (1 mark)
   A. Balaam
   B. Joseph
   C. Samson
   D. Daniel

16. What did Jesus tell the man after telling the story of the Good Samaritan? (1 mark)
   A. Go and rest
   B. Go and do likewise
   C. Go and count
   D. Go and wait

17. Who is a needy person? (1 mark)
   A. Only foreigners
   B. Someone who lacks important things like food or clothing
   C. Only adults
   D. Someone who is wealthy

18. What does the mustard seed stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A big city
   B. A rich king
   C. The end of the world
   D. The small beginning of God's kingdom

19. Who visited Jesus at night? (1 mark)
   A. Zacchaeus
   B. Samson
   C. Nicodemus
   D. Balaam

20. Who was tempted by Potiphar's wife? (1 mark)
   A. Daniel
   B. Joseph
   C. Samson
   D. Abraham

21. What is a lie? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A false statement told to deceive
   C. A true story
   D. A song

22. Which verse says that truthful lips endure for ever? (1 mark)
   A. Proverbs 1:7
   B. Proverbs 12:19
   C. John 3:16
   D. Acts 2:38

23. Which action shows obedience to school rules? (1 mark)
   A. Fighting
   B. Coming late
   C. Keeping the compound clean
   D. Leaving without permission

24. Who tried to run away from God's task? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. Jonah
   C. Daniel
   D. Stephen

25. Which chore shows responsibility at home? (1 mark)
   A. Complaining
   B. Breaking plates
   C. Hiding
   D. Washing plates

26. What does Psalm 122:1 say people were glad to do? (1 mark)
   A. Go to war
   B. Go to sleep
   C. Go to market
   D. Go to the house of the Lord

27. What does it mean to stand firm in faith? (1 mark)
   A. To keep believing and doing right under pressure
   B. To hide
   C. To copy others
   D. To give up

28. In which city were believers first called Christians? (1 mark)
   A. Jericho
   B. Nazareth
   C. Antioch
   D. Jerusalem

29. Which is a good habit in prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Never praying
   B. Praying only when scared
   C. Praying morning and evening
   D. Praying only in church

30. Which of these is a digital device? (1 mark)
   A. A mobile phone
   B. A chair
   C. A pencil
   D. A stone

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Give two things that make each person unique. (2 marks)

32. State three things that show that Nicodemus changed. (3 marks)

33. Explain how Genesis 1:27 and Psalm 139 help a child who feels unimportant. (5 marks)

34. State three lessons from the story of Zacchaeus. (3 marks)

35. Who were the parents of John the Baptist? (2 marks)

36. Write John 3:16 in your own words and explain what it teaches. (4 marks)

37. Give two words that describe Joseph's character in this story. (2 marks)

38. Explain what the word "sole" means when we say God is the sole Creator. (3 marks)

39. Explain how the story of Samson and the lion shows God's power. (3 marks)

40. Explain the meaning of Proverbs 25:28. (3 marks)

41. Explain what the Lord's Prayer teaches about forgiveness and protection. (5 marks)

42. List six of the twelve disciples. (3 marks)

43. State three lessons that we learn from the story of Joseph interpreting the dream. (3 marks)

44. Describe four steps of how to pray. (4 marks)

45. Who was Nicodemus? (2 marks)

46. State three qualities of Mary that a child can copy. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Psalm 139
   Psalm 139:14 speaks of being fearfully and wonderfully made.

2. C — The sun, moon and stars
   Genesis 1 says that God made the sun, moon and stars, and also the land, sea, plants and animals.

3. C — Daniel
   Daniel 1:8 says that he decided not to defile himself.

4. B — A decision to do one thing instead of another
   A choice means deciding between different actions.

5. D — No, stop!
   Say no loudly and clearly, then move away.

6. A — Be careful and stay in open places
   Safe places and caution protect you.

7. D — Genesis to Deuteronomy
   The first five books are called the Law.

8. C — Revelation
   Revelation is the last book of the New Testament and of the Bible.

9. D — Seven years of famine
   The thin cows were seven years of famine.

10. A — Repent
   John called people to turn from their sins.

11. B — Priest
   Luke 1:5 says he was a priest.

12. D — A child who thanks her neighbour for a kind act
   Saying thank you shows gratitude.

13. C — Comforting a grieving friend
   Comfort shows care.

14. B — Become friends again after a quarrel
   Reconcile means to make peace.

15. B — Joseph
   Joseph forgave his brothers in Egypt.

16. B — Go and do likewise
   Luke 10:37 says, "Go and do likewise."

17. B — Someone who lacks important things like food or clothing
   Needy people lack basic things.

18. D — The small beginning of God's kingdom
   God's kingdom began small.

19. C — Nicodemus
   John 3:1-2 says Nicodemus came at night.

20. B — Joseph
   Genesis 39 tells the story of Joseph.

21. B — A false statement told to deceive
   A lie is not true and is told to deceive.

22. B — Proverbs 12:19
   Proverbs 12:19 says this.

23. C — Keeping the compound clean
   Following rules shows responsibility.

24. B — Jonah
   Jonah ran away before he obeyed.

25. D — Washing plates
   Doing chores shows duty.

26. D — Go to the house of the Lord
   The psalm rejoices at going to God's house.

27. A — To keep believing and doing right under pressure
   Standing firm means not giving in.

28. C — Antioch
   Acts 11:26.

29. C — Praying morning and evening
   Regular prayer builds faith.

30. A — A mobile phone
   A phone is an electronic device.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fingerprints, voice, face, talents, likes and dislikes. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid answer.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: He defended Jesus fairly; he brought spices for Jesus' burial; he showed courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid sign.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: Genesis 1:27 says people are made in God's image, so every person is valuable. Psalm 139 says we are fearfully and wonderfully made, so God took great care in making us. God also knows us by name. Therefore no child is unimportant, and we should respect ourselves and others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Genesis 1:27 meaning, 1 for Psalm 139 meaning, 1 for God knowing us by name, 1 for the conclusion, 1 for a clear link to the child's feelings.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus loves everyone, even those others reject; repentance means changing and putting things right; we should be honest with money and share with the poor.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: Zechariah and Elizabeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: God loved the world so much that He gave His only Son so that everyone who believes in Him will not be lost but will have eternal life. It teaches God's love and the way to eternal life.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for giving Jesus, 1 for believing, 1 for eternal life.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wise, honest, humble, faithful, hardworking, trusting in God. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid word.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sole means only. God alone made everything. Nobody helped Him and nobody made Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning of sole, 1 for God alone creating, 1 for no helper.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Samson had no weapon, but the Spirit of the Lord gave him strength to tear a lion apart. This shows God's power is greater than any danger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for no weapon, 1 for the Spirit giving strength, 1 for God's power.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: A person without self-control is like a city with broken walls, easily attacked and unprotected. Self-control protects us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for broken walls, 1 for unprotected, 1 for self-control protecting.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: We ask God to forgive us as we forgive others, so we must forgive. We ask Him to lead us away from temptation and to deliver us from evil, so we depend on His protection and try to avoid wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's forgiveness, 1 for forgiving others, 1 for temptation, 1 for evil, 1 for depending on God.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Peter, Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot, Judas Iscariot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each two correct names up to 3 marks.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Depend on God; do not give up when life is unfair; use gifts to serve others; save for hard times.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Find a quiet moment, speak with respect, thank Him, say sorry, ask for help, say Amen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step up to 4.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: A Pharisee and a member of the Jewish ruling council who visited Jesus at night.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Pharisee or leader and 1 for visiting Jesus.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trust in God, obedience, humility, purity.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each quality.
